units.translation: 536-41a. Or in Pytho or perhaps in Ortygia: in Delos. The sequence is as follows: just as young men in Delphi or in Delos or on the Ismenus, having set up a dance around the altar of Apollo, beat the ground with their feet in time to the lyre's melody, so these men, charmed by Orpheus' lyre, drove the ship more vigorously. The sequence is: they strike together. The preposition hypo is derived as in Homer (Iliad 2.824) 'beneath the lowest foot of Ida.'
b. Ismenus: Ismenus is a river of Boeotia, on which there is a sanctuary of Ismenian Apollo. Lm P
c. And the waves were dashed upon: meaning: the waves were dashed upon. Lg
542a. With foam: meaning with foam. Lg
b. The sea gushed: the sea was thrown up and leaped up on either side of the ship. L
543. Roaring: terribly disturbed and moving fearfully. In the earlier edition: 'roaring with the blows of mighty men'.
544. And it flashed beneath the sun: for the adornment of the ship they are accustomed to attach ornaments.

545-46. And long white lines: the sense: the water was whitened like a path through a grassy plain. Or otherwise: just as a road is visible in the midst of a grassy plain, so also the track of the ship appeared.

547-48. Of demigod men: through this he confirmed that even the gods watched and marveled at the voyage; for they were not simply some sailors, but demigods. The ship is set as a wonder for all, having been made by Athena.

551a. Of Itonian Athena: there is a sanctuary of Itonian Athena in Coronea in Boeotia. However, Apollonius would not say that Athena was called from the epithet in Coronea for the building of the Argo, but rather from the Thessalian Itonia, about which Hecataeus in the first book of his Histories (1 fg 2 J.) says: but Armenidas in his Thebaica (fg 1 M. IV 339) says that Itonus, son of Amphictyon, was born in Thessaly, from whom the city Iton and Itonian Athena are named. Alexander also mentions it in the first book of his commentary on Corinna (fg 30 B. III 551) (fg 53 M. III 234).
b. Tritonian: it is written Itonian. LgP
554. And on the gray break of the wave: on the shore, where the waves break around.
